preview.name: rubato

nodes.description: Shared serde types, JSON Schema export, OTel attribute names and limits. No I/O.
One per developer machine. Outbound only. Runs tmux, git worktree and claude for its paired user.
One per team. Map, pins, plans, progress derivation, decisions, GitHub OAuth, websocket fan-out, embeds web.
React map view served by the server.
Claude Code skill installed in every connected repo. Loads map and ADRs, writes the plan, ships hook config.
GitHub Action. Fails a PR whose plan names an unknown id or lacks an O-row per seam.
The plan Markdown on an issue branch. Affected-parts and O-rows tables parsed to JSON.
A team's system-map.yml. Node and seam ids referenced by pins and plans.
Issues, comments, PRs, checks, OAuth, REST, Projects v2 GraphQL, plan files on branches.
Session runner (TypeScript CLI, npm tmux-ide, tmux >= 3.7). worktree create, events, team --json, send, wait, MCP. Version pinned by the companion.
The only agent in v0. Hooks are the event source. Exports its own OTel.

preview.owner_rule: The owner side of a seam is the node whose team is woken when the seam breaks. For a seam with an external node, the owner is always the Rubato side.

scenarios.description: A person starts a Claude Code session on a pinned issue, on their own companion, and sees it working on the map.
scenarios.name: Start a session on an issue

steps.says: you press Start on a pinned issue

steps.carries: LaunchCommand, for the paired user only
steps.says: the server sends the launch to your own companion only
the companion creates a worktree on the issue branch
Claude Code starts with hooks and telemetry attributes
the launch result and the new session come back
every browser is told something changed
the issue shows Started
the session fires hooks as it works
hook events reach the server
browsers are told again
the issue shows Designing

scenarios.description: The agent plans from the map, the plan check reads it on the pull request, and the server paints the map with it.
scenarios.name: A plan comes back

steps.says: the skill offers the session the map's ids and flows
the plan is written on the issue branch
the Action reads the plan
pass or fail on the pull request
the server reads the plan from the branch
browsers are told
the affected parts light up; the issue shows Designed

scenarios.description: The team edits the map as one shared draft, proposes it as a pull request, and the merged map comes back.
scenarios.name: Propose a map change

steps.says: a person adds a part or a seam to the draft
someone proposes the draft
the draft becomes a change to the map file
a branch, a commit and a pull request, as the App

steps.carries: open issues, issue state, Decision: comments, pull requests, check runs, plan files and the map from branches
steps.says: the pull request merges and the server reads the new map
the map is validated and loaded
browsers are told
everyone sees the new map
